newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Nutricia withdraws baby food from France.
newsitem.headline: Nutricia withdraws baby food from France.

text.p: Dutch food group Nutricia NV said on Monday it had withdrawn a small amount of its baby food brand "Lemiel 2" from French shops "as a precaution" after two cases of salmonella.

Nutricia said the salmonella cases, which appeared in September and October last year were similar to the recent cases in Britain, which resulted in the withdrawl of its Milumil brand. To prevent any possible risk, Nutricia said it had decided to withdraw from French shops the Lemiel 2 product made during July last year.
There have no new cases of salmonella in France since October last year, it added.
Last week, Nutricia said British health authorities had not been able to find any contaminants in its Milumil product.
